name: inv-1-no-sheetjs-runtime-import
description: INV-1 (FR-042): SheetJS (the `xlsx` npm package) is a development-only differential oracle. No production source may import it; only *.test.ts files and the dedicated oracle harness (sheetjs-oracle.ts) may.
fixHint: Use the streaming reader in @fuguejs/xlsx (openWorkbook / foldRows / parseWorkbook). SheetJS may only be imported from *.test.ts files or packages/xlsx/src/__tests__/support/sheetjs-oracle.ts, as the differential reference.
